difficulty_strata: within-language rank tertiles named near, middle, far

rendering.wrap_semantics: token-preserving visual soft wrap after lexing; continuation rows have no source line number

analysis.primary_inference: pair-level regression with crossed snippet cluster-robust uncertainty (snippet_i and snippet_j); language interactions use the Dorn-only three-language subset
analysis.pairwise_test: exact McNemar on matched binary pair outcomes as a sensitivity analysis
analysis.omnibus_test: Cochran Q on complete matched binary outcomes as a sensitivity analysis
analysis.multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction within each model-language-endpoint family
analysis.difficulty_reporting: continuous interaction plus descriptive rank tertiles; legacy thresholds are reproducibility-only
analysis.blur_reporting: categorical condition interaction primary; ordinal sigma trend secondary because sigma 4 may reach an OCR floor
analysis.embedding_reporting: continuous estimates with bootstrap confidence intervals and permutation null; no fixed R=0.5/0.8 labels
